verdict.rationale: Plausible documents API keys scoped to a single team, which limits which sites a key can query. The Stats API those keys target is read-only, so a key handed to an agent gets coarse least-privilege access to that team's stats. Missing for 10: per-site or per-endpoint permission scopes, choosing between read and write scopes per key, key expiry/rotation or revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API keys are scoped to one team. The team selected in the top-right menu when you create the key determines which sites it can query.
Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
